question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘stimulate’ from the following sentence.

His jovial nature energises and charms the whole auditorium.
solution:
The correct answer is “**Energises**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• '**Stimulate**' means to provoke or elicit a reaction or response.(उत्तेजित करना)

 
 
• **Example**-The economy was not stimulated by the large investment.
 
 
 
• '**Energises**' means to give vitality and enthusiasm to.(ऊर्जा देना)
 
 
• **Example**- The speaker's passionate talk energised the crowd.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is similar in meaning to the given word 'stimulate' is 'Energises'.

Therefore, the correct answer is** ‘Option 1’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options:
 
• **Charms**: The power or quality of delightful or attracting others. (मनोहारी)
 
• **Jovial**: Characterized by hearty, joyous humor or a spirit of good-fellowship. (हर्षित)
 
• **Auditorium**: A large room or building where people gather to hear a performance or speech. (सभागार)
